arguments.description: Update ledger line count and SHA fragments
arguments.command: $p='AUDIT_LEDGER.md'; $t=Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $p; $t=$t.Replace('475 lines','479 lines'); $t=$t.Replace('21891 bytes, SHA256 3149FBEC192BB90098370B690A7AE0D40E6277A868C66046AF3E07F165DEBB01','22179 bytes, SHA256 538ED9D32495A5E089AD47C74ADEDF488118F55F8D222713A3682D1D3CF8DCBC'); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p), $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

data.label: $p='AUDIT_LEDGER.md'; $t=Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 $p; $t=$t.Replace('475 lines','479 lines'); $t=$t.Replace('21891 bytes, SHA256 3149FBEC192BB90098370B690A7AE0D40E6277A868C66046AF3E07F165DEBB01','22179 bytes, SHA256 538ED9D32495A5E089AD47C74ADEDF488118F55F8D222713A3682D1D3CF8DCBC'); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $p), $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
